scope: H5 open-arena DCM-control history-response representation only
scientific_role: mechanism-definition and identifiability decision; not parameter fitting, ranking, or promotion evidence

alpha_search_200.meaning: Maximum H5 origin-oriented mixture probability at the arena boundary for recent_constrained_travel_mm = 200, before the frozen radial factor is applied.

alpha_search_1000.meaning: Maximum H5 origin-oriented mixture probability at the arena boundary for recent_constrained_travel_mm = 1000, before the frozen radial factor is applied.

decision.mixture_rule: For supported L, w = alpha_search_L * R(X,O,arena), with R the already-frozen boundary-normalized linear radial gate.
decision.unsupported_history_rule: H5-v1 is scientifically defined only for L=200 mm and L=1000 mm. Any other recent_constrained_travel_mm must be rejected as unsupported rather than interpolated or extrapolated.
decision.treatment_label_rule: The implementation must branch only on the numeric biological input recent_constrained_travel_mm. It may not read the short/long condition label, Path_length label, experiment id, or treatment id.

structural_identifiability.two_level_limitation: The development assay contains only two history distances, 200 mm and 1000 mm. Two effective response values can be learned at those two support points, but the shape of a continuous history-response curve between or beyond them is not empirically identified.
structural_identifiability.exponential_identity: For an exponential alpha(L)=rho*exp(-L/lambda) with alpha200>alpha1000>0, lambda = 800 / ln(alpha200/alpha1000) and rho = alpha200*exp(200/lambda). Therefore lambda and rho are merely a nonlinear reparameterization of the two endpoint amplitudes at the observed support points.
structural_identifiability.equal_effect_limit: As alpha200/alpha1000 approaches 1, lambda tends to infinity. Equal positive endpoint amplitudes correspond to a constant-history limit, not a finite identified decay length.
structural_identifiability.feasible_set_warning: Specific curve families can impose arbitrary extra restrictions on otherwise valid endpoint probabilities. Example: alpha200=0.6 and alpha1000=0.05 requires rho>1 for the simple exponential and has no positive-scale solution for the tested reciprocal form, even though the endpoint probabilities themselves are valid.
structural_identifiability.claim_rule: H5-v1 may report and interpret alpha_search_200, alpha_search_1000, their difference, and their ratio when defined. It may not report a biological lambda_search_mm, interpolation shape, extrapolated response, or travel-distance half-life.

nested_scientific_submodels.H5_common_origin_search: alpha200=alpha1000>0: origin-referenced search exists but is not modulated by recent travel distance.
nested_scientific_submodels.H5_history_modulated: alpha200>alpha1000>=0: shorter recent constrained travel has stronger origin-referenced search.
nested_scientific_submodels.future_estimator_requirement: A later frozen H5 estimator policy must distinguish evidence for origin-referenced search from evidence for history modulation. Beating only H5-exact-null is not sufficient to claim history modulation if the selected solution is compatible with the common-origin-search submodel. The estimator policy must include an explicit common-search comparator or an equivalently strict pre-frozen held-out guard.

mathematical_stress_audit.sensitivity_example: At an endpoint ratio of 1.01, increasing that ratio by only 1% changes the implied lambda from about 80,399 mm to about 40,200 mm, a 50% change.

rejected_alternatives.name: exponential_history_curve
rejected_alternatives.reason: With only two observed history levels and two curve parameters, lambda and rho do not test curve shape; they reparameterize the two endpoint strengths, become unstable near equal endpoints, impose extra feasible-set assumptions, and invite unsupported interpolation/extrapolation claims.

rejected_alternatives.name: reciprocal_or_other_two_parameter_continuous_curve
rejected_alternatives.reason: Any two-parameter family that is tuned to the two observed support points can reproduce the same in-domain behavior while making different untested predictions elsewhere.

rejected_alternatives.name: linear_interpolation_or_clamped_extrapolation
rejected_alternatives.reason: It would be an arbitrary curve-shape assumption unsupported by observations between or outside 200 and 1000 mm. Future intermediate-distance data can define a separately versioned response law.

implementation_contract.radial_combination: multiply the selected endpoint alpha by the frozen boundary-normalized linear R
implementation_contract.rng: history lookup itself consumes no RNG; dedicated H5 choice/search-angle streams remain separate from H3 streams

remaining_unfrozen_items: Whether the H5 search-direction component reuses the baseline H3 reorientation concentration exactly or has a separately justified concentration. The current draft says reuse is the pre-freeze default but this has not yet been explicitly frozen.
The final H5-null/common/history estimator nuisance family, parameter-coordinate mapping, candidate budget, scoring/promotion guards, and exact search policy.
next_step: Freeze the H5 search-direction concentration/dispersion rule, then freeze the estimator nuisance/comparator/search policy before any persistent H5 runtime implementation or parameter search.
